about.content:
THE ENGINEERING STUDIO FOR VISIONARY VENTURES

Where Ambitious Visions Take Flight Through Unyielding Engineering Craft

UraanTech is an elite multidisciplinary software, AI automation, and defensive cybersecurity studio. We eliminate the friction between brand identity, distributed cloud systems, autonomous intelligence, and bank-grade security—engineering resilient digital platforms that dominate markets.

Book an Architecture Discovery Call → Explore Our Engineering Manifesto
OUR STRATEGIC HORIZON

Pioneering the Global Standard for Resilient, Sovereign Technology

Setting an uncompromising engineering benchmark for how modern software is built: deterministic, auditable, hyper-scalable, and protected against adversarial threats.

🔭
OUR VISION

The World's Most Trusted Venture Studio

To be the sovereign engineering partner ambitious founders and enterprise leaders trust to architect their most critical digital systems, orchestrate high-leverage AI workflows, and fortify operations against systemic risk.

VELOCITY Autonomous Multiplier: Engineering deterministic AI pipelines that eliminate operational drag and unlock 10x team leverage.
SOVEREIGNTY Zero-Trust Defensibility: Cryptographically sound, auditable architectures where client data and proprietary IP remain 100% sovereign.
SCALE Global Delivery Footprint: Battle-tested architectures powering high-growth ventures across the US, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Australia.
🎯
OUR MISSION

Eradicating Agency Fragmentation & Fragile Code

To permanently replace the bloated overhead, broken handoffs, and technical debt of legacy agencies by putting senior systems architects, AI engineers, and security researchers directly at the table with client leadership from Day Zero.

SENIOR CRAFT Direct Senior Access: Direct architectural collaboration with senior craftspeople—zero junior outsourcing, zero middle-management telephone games.
INTEGRITY Deterministic Rigor: Uncompromising rejection of hype-driven shortcuts, unvalidated AI wrappers, and unvetted open-source vulnerabilities.
OWNERSHIP Absolute Sovereignty: 100% IP ownership, transparent Git histories, clean Docker configurations, and comprehensive architectural documentation.
THE URAANTECH ORIGIN & PHILOSOPHY

Built from the Conviction That Great Software Demands Unified Craft

In Urdu, the word "Uraan" (اڑان) embodies flight, breakthrough, and unstoppable upward ascent. We founded UraanTech because modern software development is fundamentally broken by agency fragmentation.

When ambitious businesses set out to build modern software, they are typically forced to coordinate four siloed vendors: a creative design agency that doesn't understand backend scalability, an offshore dev shop that writes fragile code with clunky UI, a hype-driven AI freelancer who exposes private credentials to public models, and a compliance auditor who delivers a confusing 80-page PDF checklist without fixing a single line of code.

The inevitable outcome is technical debt, finger-pointing, blown budgets, and vulnerable software. UraanTech is the unified antidote. Under one roof, our senior architects, machine learning engineers, product designers, and penetration testers work as an integrated unit to design, build, automate, and defend category-defining systems.

100% In-House Senior Engineers & Designers
0 Account Executive "Telephone" Layers
2-4 Wk Focused Milestone Delivery Cycles
100% Client IP & Code Ownership

Every application, cloud deployment, and AI workflow we engineer is built to withstand rigorous enterprise compliance audits and adversary penetration tests.

STANDARD ISO/IEC 27001:2022

Zero-trust VPC subnets, AWS KMS envelope encryption, least-privilege IAM policies, and auto-scaling container clusters managed via Docker and Terraform.

PILLAR AWS Security & Ops
THREAT RESILIENCE NIST Aligned

NIST Cybersecurity Framework

Systematic operational alignment with the 6 core NIST CSF 2.0 functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover across corporate assets.

GDPR, HIPAA & AI Data Privacy

REGULATION EU GDPR / US HIPAA
CORE DIFFERENTIATORS

Engineering Truth Over Agency Fluff

We establish trust through verifiable code architecture, zero-trust cloud security, and predictable execution velocity—not stock logos or empty marketing claims.

🛡

Security-by-Design, Not an Afterthought

Every backend endpoint, container manifest, and database query undergoes rigorous OWASP Top 10 hardening, token validation, and simulated penetration testing before reaching staging. We build software ready for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance on Day One.

⚡

Deterministic AI & Production RAG Pipelines

We reject fragile no-code hacks. Our production AI architectures utilize strict JSON Schema validation, 1536-D vector search with source attribution, and deterministic fallback logic so your operations never fail from model hallucinations or API rate limits.

🔍

Direct Principal Architecture Access

You collaborate directly with the software architects and product designers building your application via dedicated Slack or Discord channels. Zero middle-management account executives playing telephone with your technical requirements.

🚀

Rapid 2-to-4 Week Milestone Execution Sprints

We structure every engagement into disciplined 2-to-4 week milestones with automated CI/CD deployment. You review interactive prototypes and live staging previews every single week—with absolute scope transparency and zero surprise invoices.

OUR ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES

The Code Standards We Live By

An uncompromising engineering constitution that governs every architecture decision, commit, and deployment.

🔑

Sovereign IP & Zero Lock-in

You maintain 100% ownership of your Git repositories, Docker containers, database migrations, and Figma design tokens upon every milestone completion.

💻

Deterministic Reliability

We prioritize type-safe TypeScript, resilient Python microservices, and idempotent distributed webhook handlers built to survive network partitions and high traffic spikes.

⚙

Strict Data Governance

We enforce Zero Data Retention agreements with model providers, provide localized VPC self-hosting options, and apply end-to-end encryption for all enterprise data assets.

DATA PRIVACY & COMPLIANCE STANDARDS

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026. Data handling, corporate telemetry, and privacy commitments governing all web interactions and digital consultations with UraanTech.

Executive Data Governance Principles

  • Zero Public AI Training: We guarantee that proprietary client datasets, private source code, and enterprise credentials are never ingested or utilized to train commercial foundation models.
  • Commercial Necessity Only: Personal and corporate data is processed strictly to provide architecture roadmaps, execute SOW contracts, and communicate regarding deliverables.
  • No Third-Party Data Monetization: UraanTech never sells, rents, leases, or trades client inquiry data to third-party data brokers or marketing aggregators.
  • Bank-Grade Transport Security: All client communications and web interactions are guarded by TLS 1.3 encryption and automated DDoS mitigation infrastructure.

1. Information We Collect

UraanTech collects information directly from commercial entities and authorized corporate representatives through website forms, direct email correspondence, telephone discussions, and official WhatsApp channels:

  • Corporate Contact Details: Full name, professional work email address, company title, business phone/WhatsApp number, and geographical corporate headquarters.
  • Project Scoping Specifications: Technical architecture requirements, estimated investment parameters, existing technology stack descriptions, and targeted milestone timelines.
  • Automated Telemetry & Security Logs: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser user agents, referring URLs, request timestamps, and firewall telemetry collected automatically for load balancing, intrusion detection, and DDoS prevention.

2. Lawful Basis & Purpose of Processing

UraanTech processes collected information strictly under legitimate business interests and pre-contractual commercial necessity:

  • To formulate milestone proposals, architectural estimates, resource allocations, and fixed-price Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • To communicate directly regarding ongoing sprints, code check-ins, staging preview links, and invoice settlements.
  • By submitting an inquiry or scheduling a consultation, the Client provides explicit consent for UraanTech engineers and account leads to contact the Client via email, telephone, or official WhatsApp channels regarding their submitted project scope.

3. Zero Foundation AI Model Training Guarantee

UraanTech maintains strict intellectual data sovereignty protocols. We explicitly warrant that no client source code, confidential database schemas, proprietary algorithms, or corporate data provided to UraanTech will be submitted, utilized, or exposed to train, retrain, or fine-tune any public, commercial, or third-party artificial intelligence foundation models (including OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google models). All AI pipeline development for clients is deployed within isolated, single-tenant, private enterprise VPC configurations.

4. Authorized Subprocessors & Cloud Infrastructure Disclaimer

To deliver high-availability engineering services, UraanTech contracts with tier-1, SOC2 Type II, and ISO 27001-certified global infrastructure subprocessors, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloudflare (CDN/WAF), GitHub (Version Control), and Meta/WhatsApp (Instant Messaging API). While UraanTech selects enterprise-grade vendors, UraanTech does not control the independent uptime or operational continuity of third-party cloud infrastructure providers and disclaims liability for upstream telecommunication or third-party server interruptions.

5. Security Safeguards & Transmission Disclaimer

UraanTech implements robust industry-standard safeguards, including TLS 1.3 encryption for web transit and AES-256 encryption for internal documentation. However, the Client acknowledges that transmission of data across the public internet can never be guaranteed as 100% impenetrable. Consequently, while UraanTech applies rigorous protective measures, the Client transmits preliminary scoping data and documentation at its own operational risk.

6. Data Retention, Accounting Records & Deletion Rights

Commercial inquiry records, project communications, and financial transaction data are retained for as long as necessary to fulfill active contractual obligations, provide post-release warranty support, and comply with mandatory statutory corporate, tax, and accounting regulations. Commercial clients may request the review, rectification, or permanent deletion of non-essential marketing records by submitting a verified written request to info@uraantech.online.

7. Amendments & Policy Governance

UraanTech reserves the right to amend, update, or modify this Privacy Policy at any time without prior individual notice by publishing the revised version on this website with an updated revision date. Continued utilization of UraanTech' website or engineering services following any modification constitutes full acceptance of the revised terms. This policy shall be governed in accordance with applicable laws in Sindh, Pakistan.

8. Data Protection & Security Desk

For data privacy verifications, enterprise compliance inquiries, or mutual NDA executions, contact our technical desk directly:

COMMERCIAL GOVERNANCE & SOW TERMS

Terms of Service

Last updated: October 2026. Standard commercial conditions governing all software engineering, AI deployment, VAPT auditing, and architecture engagements executed by UraanTech.

Key Commercial Terms at a Glance

  • Conditional IP Assignment: Custom code and deliverables transfer to the Client strictly upon 100% receipt of cleared milestone funds. UraanTech withholds all IP rights until full payment.
  • Scope Containment: Features or changes outside the agreed Statement of Work (SOW) require a written Change Order at architectural hourly rates ($75–$150/hr).
  • 7-Day Deemed Acceptance: Sprints and deliverables submitted for review are deemed 100% accepted if no itemized written defects are submitted within 7 calendar days.
  • Liability Cap: UraanTech' aggregate liability for any engagement is strictly capped at the fees actually received for the specific milestone in dispute.

1. Scope of Agreement & Contractual Hierarchy

These Terms of Service ("Terms") constitute a legally binding agreement between UraanTech ("Studio", "Agency", "we", "us") and the ordering entity ("Client", "Customer", "you"). All projects, architecture discovery calls, and software deployments are executed pursuant to a Statement of Work (SOW) or proposal. In the event of any ambiguity, the signed SOW governs milestone specifics, while these Terms govern all payments, IP retention, liability, and dispute proceedings.

2. Milestone Payments, Deposits & Stop-Work Rights

Engineering sprints and technical allocations are scheduled based on clear financial commitments:

  • Non-Refundable Onboarding Deposits: Project initiation requires an initial deposit (typically 30% to 50% of the SOW valuation). All deposits and sprint disbursements are strictly non-refundable once architectural work or engineering allocations have commenced.
  • Invoicing & Due Dates: Milestone invoices are payable upon presentation (Net-7). Any invoice unpaid after seven (7) calendar days shall accrue a compounding late finance charge of 1.5% per month (or the maximum statutory limit).
  • Immediate Stop-Work Remedy: If the Client fails to pay any milestone invoice when due, UraanTech reserves the absolute right, without breach or liability, to immediately pause all active engineering, freeze staging environments, revoke repository commit privileges, and withhold deployment credentials until all balances are settled in full.

3. Intellectual Property Reservation & Background IP

UraanTech maintains strict protection over its engineering outputs and proprietary tooling:

  • Retention of Title: Full title, copyright, and intellectual property in all custom code, UI designs, database schemas, and deliverables remain the exclusive property of UraanTech until all fees, taxes, and change orders associated with the project have been paid in full with cleared funds.
  • Unauthorized Pre-Payment Use: The Client is granted zero license to deploy, compile, distribute, or commercially exploit any deliverable prior to 100% invoice settlement. Any deployment of unpaid software constitutes willful copyright infringement and an immediate breach of contract.
  • Background IP & Developer Tooling: UraanTech retains perpetual, global, unencumbered ownership of all pre-existing design tokens, boilerplate repositories, AI agent scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, cryptographic scripts, and architectural methodologies ("Background IP"). Upon final payment, the Client receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use such Background IP solely as integrated within the deliverable.

4. Scope Creep, Change Orders & 7-Day Deemed Acceptance

To ensure project momentum and protect against uncompensated scope expansion:

  • Strict Scope Boundaries: UraanTech is obligated to build only the deliverables explicitly itemized in the approved SOW. Any extra feature, altered user flow, third-party API substitution, or design overhaul requested by the Client constitutes an out-of-scope "Change Order", billable at UraanTech' standard architectural rate of $75 to $150 per hour or a separate fixed addendum.
  • 7-Day Deemed Acceptance: Following milestone delivery to staging or git commit check-in, the Client is granted seven (7) calendar days to perform verification. If the Client does not submit an itemized written defect notice within this 7-day period, the milestone shall be deemed irrevocably approved, accepted, and cleared for milestone disbursement.

5. Client Dependencies & Inactivity Freeze

Timely project completion depends on prompt Client collaboration. The Client agrees to deliver requested database access, third-party API credentials, domain DNS records, and design feedback within five (5) business days of request. If a project is delayed for more than ten (10) consecutive business days due to Client unresponsive conduct, UraanTech may freeze the project, release scheduled engineering resources without penalty, and require a 15% reactivation fee to reschedule.

6. Absolute Limitation of Liability

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW:

  • IN NO EVENT SHALL URAANTECH, ITS SENIOR ARCHITECTS, DIRECTORS, CONTRACTORS, OR AFFILIATES BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO LOSS OF PROFITS, LOSS OF REVENUE, LOSS OF BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY, LOSS OF DATA, SYSTEM DOWNTIME, OR REPUTATIONAL DAMAGE, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SERVICES.
  • URAANTECH' TOTAL CUMULATIVE AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ALL CLAIMS OF ANY KIND (WHETHER IN CONTRACT, TORT, NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR INDEMNITY) SHALL NOT EXCEED THE TOTAL NET AMOUNT ACTUALLY RECEIVED BY URAANTECH FROM THE CLIENT FOR THE SPECIFIC MILESTONE IN DISPUTE DURING THE THIRTY (30) DAYS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE OCCURRENCE GIVING RISE TO LIABILITY.

7. Cybersecurity, Penetration Testing & VAPT Disclaimers

For cybersecurity assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing (VAPT):

  • VAPT audits and source code reviews evaluate security posture at a single point in time based on agreed scopes and publicly known vulnerability signatures. UraanTech DOES NOT warrant that an audited application, network, or smart contract is 100% impenetrable or immune from future zero-day vulnerabilities, social engineering, credential stuffing, or subsequent code changes.
  • The Client assumes full operational responsibility for patching identified vulnerabilities. The Client agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold UraanTech harmless against any regulatory fines, ransomware losses, or third-party lawsuits resulting from security breaches on the Client's infrastructure.

8. Limited 30-Day Bug Warranty & "As-Is" Cloud Deployments

Following final production handover, UraanTech provides a complimentary thirty (30) day functional defect warranty strictly covering reproducible deviations from the signed SOW specifications. This warranty is voided immediately if the codebase is modified, refactored, or updated by the Client or any third-party engineer. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED, ALL SERVICES, SCRIPTS, AND DELIVERABLES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR UNINTERRUPTED AVAILABILITY.

9. Portfolio & Marketing Attribution

Under no circumstances shall previously disbursed milestone fees or deposits be subject to clawback or refund.

These Terms, all SOWs, and any commercial disputes arising from engagements with UraanTech shall be governed exclusively by the laws of Sindh, Pakistan, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
